item.title: MRC: partnership grant: applicant-led
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
Apply for funding to support exciting and ambitious partnerships within the remit of the Medical Research Council. You must be employed by an eligible research organisation. Partnerships are novel collaborative activities between researchers to transform our understanding of human health and disease.

MRC

item.title: MRC: new investigator research grant: applicant-led
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
Apply for funding to take the next step towards becoming an independent researcher. Doing exciting and ambitious research within the remit of the Medical Research Council. You must have the:
  • skills and experience to ‘transition to independence’
  • support of an eligible host research organisation

MRC

item.title: MRC: research grant: applicant-led
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
Apply for funding to support exciting and ambitious research within the remit of the Medical Research Council, to transform our understanding of human health and disease You must be employed by an eligible research organisation. You can involve more than one research group or organisation in the project.

MRC

item.title: Mid-range equipment for biosciences research: ALERT 2026
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
Apply for funding to purchase mid-range equipment for research across BBSRC’s scientific remit through ALERT 2026. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for BBSRC funding. Research technical professionals are eligible as project leads or project co-leads for this funding opportunity.

BBSRC

item.title: Eureka collaborative R&D: Globalstars Japan 2027
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
UK registered organisations can apply for a share of £2 million for collaborative industrial research and development (R&D) projects with partners from Japan and select Eureka countries.

Innovate UK

item.title: Capacity building: clinical research training fellowship
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
Apply for funding to reacquire research skills. Your research can focus on any area of Medical Research Council (MRC) remit to improve human health. You must:
  • be a registered healthcare professional
  • be a PhD graduate working outside of research, usually five or more years ago
  • show plans to pursue a clinical academic research career

MRC

item.title: Manufacturing Scale-up Research and Innovation: Automotive and Aerospace
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
Apply for funding to address manufacturing scale-up challenges for new technologies and processes, accelerating innovation and driving UK business growth in the automotive and aerospace sectors. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for UKRI funding.

UKRI-wide

item.title: Expression of interest: First-of-a-Kind (FOAK) builder: programme entry
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
UK-registered businesses can apply for support worth up to £315,000 to develop a climate tech FOAK project. Companies successful at this expression of interest stage could be invited to apply for a larger grant through FOAK builder phase two.

Innovate UK

item.title: Manufacturing Scale-up Network Plus
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
Opportunity to build a Network Plus to accelerate the scale-up of manufacturing innovation, driving growth across aerospace, automotive and wider UK advanced manufacturing frontier industries. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for UKRI funding.

UKRI-wide

item.title: Battery Innovation Programme: investor partnerships
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
UK registered small or medium sized businesses can apply for grant funding alongside private investment from selected investor partners.

Innovate UK

item.title: Experimental medicine: invited stage two application
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
Apply for funding to investigate the causes, progression and treatment of human disease. Your application must include an intervention in humans. You must be based at a research organisation eligible for Medical Research Council (MRC) funding. You must be invited to apply for stage two of this funding opportunity.

MRC

item.title: Experimental medicine stage one
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
Apply for funding to investigate the causes, progression and treatment of human disease. Your application must include an intervention in humans. You must be based at a research organisation eligible for Medical Research Council (MRC) funding.

MRC

item.title: ADOPT Facilitator support grant: round 12
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
Farming, growing or forestry businesses based in England can apply for a grant of £2,500, to engage an external Project Facilitator to support the development of a Full ADOPT Grant application.

Innovate UK

item.title: Public Engagement Spark Awards 2026B
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
Apply for funding to engage the public with Science and Technology Facilities Council (STFC) supported science. Applicant organisations must:
  • be UK-based
  • produce annual accounts certified by an accountant
Proposals must include an appropriate STFC subject matter expert (SME).

STFC

item.title: MDI programme innovation and scale-up hub
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
UK registered eligible organisations can apply for a share of up to £4 million for a manufacturing digitalisation innovation (MDI) and scale-up hub to improve the targeting, quality and commercial impact of grant funded activity.

Innovate UK

item.title: Experimental medicine to define mechanisms of gambling disorder: stage one
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
Apply for funding for academically led experimental medicine studies in humans that deepen understanding of the causal biological and psychosocial mechanisms underlying the effects of gambling activities, products and interventions on gambling disorder.

MRC AHRC ESRC UKRI-wide

item.title: Engineering Biology Investor Partnerships round 1
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
UK registered SMEs can apply for a share of up to £8 million to develop engineering biology products and services with selected investor partners.

Innovate UK

item.title: Frontier AI: SME Champions, phase 1
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
UK registered SME’s can apply for a share of up to £3.1 million to deliver feasibility studies for frontier artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning (ML) technologies with a clear route to defensible scale-up.

Innovate UK

item.title: CfI: counter UAS demonstrations in prison environments
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
Organisations can apply for a share of £900,000, inclusive of VAT, to demonstrate and test low-cost counter uncrewed aerial system (UAS) technologies that are able to detect and track drones within UK prison estates. This is a Contracts for Innovation (CfI) competition.

UKRI-wide

item.title: Pre-announcement: Future Data Services: Joining up the data service workforce
item.dc:creator: UKRI
item.description:
Apply for Future Data Services funding to bring together communities of practitioners to exchange knowledge, improve working practices and deliver better data services for researchers.

ESRC
